# SegmentedControl

Figma: [06l. SegmentedControl](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=4248-150234) · Family: 06 Navigation · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-07-16

A choice control with radio-group semantics - switches a mode, filters a view, toggles a range. Form-adjacent, NOT navigation. Atom (Segment) + one organism per count (_2/_3/_4/_5), LTR + RTL.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/segmented-control/reference.png`

### Segment

One option inside a SegmentedControl: label, optional icon, count and dot, with selection shown by weight and colour while the parent's thumb provides the fill.

Level: atom · Part of: SegmentedControl_2, SegmentedControl_3, SegmentedControl_4, SegmentedControl_5

Use when:
- Inside SegmentedControl_2..5; set exactly one nested Segment to State=selected
- Icon-only options (Has label off) or filter counts (Show count)

Don't use when:
- Standalone buttons: use Button or ButtonGroup
- Tabs: use SegmentedTabItem

Accessibility: role=radio with aria-checked; md/lg meet the 44pt target; icon-only segments need aria-label.

### SegmentedControl_3

Three-option pill single-select control (Day / Week / Month) that filters or toggles the same view. A radio group in a pill, not navigation.

Level: molecule · Contains: Segment

Use when:
- Chart or returns range switches (Day / Week / Month)
- Filtering a list in place (All / Active / Closed)
- Choosing a mode inside a card or calculator

Don't use when:
- Moving between different screens or views: use SegmentedTabs or TabBar
- Binary on/off: use Switch
- Long value lists: use Select
- Two or four or five options: use SegmentedControl_2, SegmentedControl_4 or SegmentedControl_5

Accessibility: role=radiogroup with an accessible label; arrow keys move selection; labels truncate, never scroll; order reverses in RTL.

| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Size | `size` | variant | sm, md, lg | sm |

### SegmentedControl_2

Two-option pill single-select control (Monthly / Yearly) for toggling a value on the same view.

Level: molecule · Contains: Segment

Use when:
- Two mutually exclusive modes such as Monthly / Yearly or Gross / Net
- Compact toggles inside cards and calculators

Don't use when:
- Simple on/off: use Switch
- Switching content views under the AppBar: use SegmentedTabs
- Three or more options: use SegmentedControl_3, _4 or _5

Accessibility: role=radiogroup; selection must not rely on colour alone (weight change plus thumb).

Four-option pill single-select control (Day / Week / Month / Year) for range or filter choices on the same view.

### SegmentedControl_5

Five-option pill single-select control with short labels (1D / 1W / 1M / 1Y / All), typically for chart time ranges.

Level: molecule · Contains: Segment

Use when:

- Five short filter options

Don't use when:

- Scrolling tab rows: use SegmentedTabs or TabBar

Accessibility: role=radiogroup; abbreviated labels need full aria-labels (1 week).

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

SegmentedControl is a compact single-select (occasionally multi-select) control for switching a mode, filtering a view, or toggling a range. It is form-adjacent - a radio group in a pill - not navigation.

> **Info:** Architecture: complexity lives in the Segment atom; selection is expressed by nested atom state, not an index variant (a flat set would explode to thousands). One organism set per count: _2 / _3 / _4 / _5. The selection indicator is a real thumb LAYER, not a segment fill - which is what lets it Smart-Animate.

### When to use - SegmentedControl vs TabBar

They look similar but are different jobs. Do not duplicate TabBar.

- SegmentedControl - a CHOICE control. Radio-group semantics: picks a value that filters/toggles the SAME view (e.g. Day / Week / Month, All / Active / Closed). Form-adjacent.
- TabBar - NAVIGATION. Moves between different destinations / views. Can scroll when tabs overflow.
- Overflow rule: SegmentedControl truncates / abbreviates labels - it never scrolls. If you need scrolling tabs, that is TabBar.
- Switch = binary on/off; ButtonGroup = actions; Select = long value lists. Reach for those when they fit better.

### Composition - how to assemble a control

- Pick the organism for your count (_2/_3/_4/_5). Its track, thumb, padding, radius and gap come from variables.
- Set selection by giving ONE nested Segment State = selected (thumb sits under it); the rest stay unselected. No index variant.
- Edit each Segment’s Label / Icon / Count on the nested instance. Add a leading icon (Has icon) or go icon-only (Has label off); add a filter count (Show count).

### Segment (atom) - properties

- State (variant): unselected · selected · hover · pressed · focus · disabled · selected-disabled.
- Size (variant): sm · md · lg - with the type ramp; md/lg meet the 44pt/48dp touch target.
- Has icon (bool) + Icon (instance-swap, bound to the icon library) · Has label (bool → icon-only when off) · Show count (bool) + Count (text) · Label (text).
- Show Dot / Show Dot right (bools) - a leading / trailing dot (bg/brand/primary) around the label. Used by the minimal style as the selection marker; available on every state.
- Selection is a text weight + colour change only - the white fill is the organism’s thumb, never the segment.

### SegmentedControl (organism) - properties

- One set per count: _2 / _3 / _4 / _5. Variant: Direction (LTR / RTL); _3 also carries Size (sm / md / lg).
- Style (variant): pill-thumb · solid · dark · minimal - all built. × Direction (LTR/RTL) × Size (sm/md/lg). Every count set (_2 / _3 / _4 / _5) carries the full 24-variant matrix. Segments fill equally.
- Track, thumb and labels are all bound to semantic variables - no raw hex. See Tokens below.

### Style lineage

- pill-thumb - grey track (bg/disabled) with a white pill (bg/surface) that slides under the selection; selected label green. The iOS default and our primary.
- solid - green-filled pill thumb (bg/brand/primary) + white label. · dark - white pill thumb + dark label. · minimal - no thumb; a leading green dot marks the selection. All single-select; outlined / multi-select is a future stage.
pill-thumb

solid

dark

minimal

### Motion

The thumb slides between segments - never fades. Model it as an interactive component: Selected-state variants wired ON_CLICK → Smart Animate (same technique as Loader 05f / ProgressBar indeterminate).

- Transition: Smart Animate, ~200ms, ease-out. Thumb translates X (and reverses direction in RTL); label colour/weight cross-fades under it.

### RTL - Arabic-first

- Segment ORDER reverses - the first segment sits at the RIGHT; the thumb starts right and slides leftward. Direction is a real variant (order + radius + thumb direction change structurally).
- position stays LOGICAL: start = right edge in RTL, and corner radius follows. Leading icons sit at start (= right); directional glyphs mirror; Latin/numeric runs stay bidi-isolated.

### Tokens & reuse

- Track bg/disabled (grey) · selected-cell thumb bg/base (#ffffff pure white, pill-thumb & dark) or bg/brand/primary (solid) · selected label text/brand/primary - or text/on-brand (solid) / text/default (dark) · unselected text/muted · dot bg/brand/primary. All bound to variables (no raw hex).
- Icon = instance-swap to the icon library. Count reuses a subtle brand-tint pill. Type: IBM Plex Sans (LTR) / Tajawal (RTL).
